feat(mobile): manage account template lifecycle

Adds cursor pagination to the typed account-templates client, exposes the
workspace cache list/image bytes and metadata-only updates, and introduces an
AccountTemplatesController with revision-guarded rename/submit/delete plus
offline cached open. GraphicEditor saves through an account-template draft
repository that PATCHes with the cached revision and rewrites the cache only
from the server response; a 409 refreshes the cache and surfaces a localized
conflict instead of overwriting. W3-A slice 4a/4b.
